title: Apple Proves Chip Design Will Always Trump Latest Technology Standards; A20 Pro Has Higher Memory Bandwidth Than Xiaomi’s XRING 03, Despite Using Older LPDD5X RAM
summary: The A20 Pro wasn’t just designed around a packaging change to enable Apple’s newest 2nm SoC to deliver raw performance gains, but it was also to improve the on-device AI experience, which meant the company’s engineers had to work some magic on increasing memory bandwidth without unnecessarily raising costs by switching to the LPDDR6 standard. The result is a chipset that edges past Xiaomi’s XRING 03, which, by the way, offers LPDDR6 RAM support but loses to the A20 Pro in memory bandwidth.
